name: managed-docker-crash-recovery
goal: Prove that a restarted offline Docker task supervisor reclaims a killed supervisor’s task container with daemon, owner and workspace evidence while concurrent live tasks and shared Docker resources survive.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Parent run-112 on MB2 proved SIGKILL leaves one running fixture and owner-plus-bind-scoped cleanup preserves the live bystander. On a later managed launch, reclaim the verified orphan automatically.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Extend the existing module-tasks Linux process lifecycle case beyond exit 37 and cancellation to a SIGKILL with an independent live managed supervisor and another launch. Reuse local pinned image and isolated workspaces.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: MB2 Docker Desktop 29.4.0, one worker and cached no-network image. Commit 46f050ac45 reported recovered:false after the next managed launch. Exit 37, cancellation, live bystander and cached-image assertions passed. Sealed Harness regression 833611546695051f2131398bfd3b4cc0992a635eb920741cd7890e5ed461a2fe.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: The explicit pilot now fsyncs an owner, supervisor start identity, engine and canonical workspace receipt before Docker create; verified full-ID cleanup is shared by normal exit, cancellation and later managed launches.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged MB2 lifecycle test passed at 50d2619b3a, one worker, Docker Desktop 29.4.0 and the cached offline image. Sealed proof 4c2a9a7c910c4334d5d383d3d064a5e981278d5436cc7857e7ae6798c8c7ecff. The exact orphan was removed; cancellation, live bystander, volume canary and cached image were preserved.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
